lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a non-linear grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits, with higher spot frequency observed in the central lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity forming intersection nodes with high-luminance blobs along the mid-flank horizontal plane.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature along the mid-lateral flank characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient with light illumination on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a localized cluster of small-diameter high-luminance spots concentrated along the leading edge and dorsal surface.
